headline: Instagram’s first wordmark refresh in a decade, Meta’s holiday clock is already running, and LinkedIn is still our weakest owned channel.

items.title: Instagram introduces a redesigned wordmark
items.summary: Adam Mosseri launched a new Instagram wordmark on 13 Aug 2026 — the first script change in ten years. The rainbow camera app icon is unchanged. Designers kept cursive so the brand still feels handmade; some users read the r as a z. New fonts shipped with it. Meta would not confirm an icon redesign.
items.fy_action: Swap any template that hard-codes the 2016 Instagram script. Do not rebuild the brand around a logo meme.

items.title: Meta publishes holiday marketing guides
items.summary: Meta’s 2026 holiday playbook says waiting until November is already late. Use Reels for discovery, Partnership ads for trust, and Advantage+ for conversion. Black Friday is 27 Nov 2026 with a short run to Christmas. SMBs were told to have ads learning by mid-October. Meta also cites heavy in-app messaging and creator-led shopping.
items.fy_action: Put NYE, Art Basel, and holiday corporate packages into Advantage+ tests in September–October. Pair with WhatsApp/message CTAs.

items.title: Meta shares holiday 2026 tips for small businesses
items.summary: Holiday Insights Center plus a 15,000-shopper survey: 85% bought in-store after seeing something on Meta apps, 59% messaged a business, 94% look to creators, and AI-assisted shopping is rising. Start ads mid-October so the model is not cold on BFCM.
items.fy_action: Treat messaging as a conversion path, not a leftover inbox. Creators on real water beat another studio still.

items.title: Social media updates and new features to know this week
items.summary: X is replacing creator revenue share with an Original Content Rewards program. LinkedIn now ranks comments by professional relevance. Meta Edits is adding beta tools. Meta One gets a larger Reels follow button, more AI Messenger replies, extra profile links, and up to three business locations. YouTube launched Live Practice Mode for private livestream rehearsal.
items.fy_action: Add Miami + Panama as locations if on Meta One. Use Live Practice Mode before a yacht walkthrough live. Seed a useful first comment on every LinkedIn post.

items.title: Social Media Trends Report: August 3, 2026
items.summary: Weekly formats: Do Not Disturb, guess-the-brand-color, home-is-anywhere, how-to-summon-me, stress cutaways. LinkedIn published more native-content guidance. YouTube published a Shorts growth guide. Instagram now allows replacing audio on already-published feed posts and carousels.
items.fy_action: Optional: a “how to summon the captain” Reel and a Biscayne “home is anywhere” still. Skip color-swatch trends unless it is a signature hull.

items.title: Social Media Today — daily desk
items.summary: Desk cluster: Meta still has the widest social reach; Instagram will charge for some AI access; Muse Spark 1.1; YouTube Studio refresh; dedicated Meta ad exclusion audiences; Google Ads and Analytics adding more AI tools; X adding Grok insights in Ads Manager. People are posting less under pressure — paid and strong creative gain share.
items.fy_action: When the booker list is ready, use the new exclusion audiences on prospecting. Do not open X ads this month.

items.title: Behind Instagram’s first major refresh in over ten years
items.summary: Instagram’s design leads kept script after testing sans-serif because the wordmark is inseparable from the product. The refresh is framed as handmade expression against corporate “blanding,” with a tighter type system and subtler gradient use.
items.fy_action: If we ever redo FY wordmarks, keep a human script or script-adjacent mark. Do not flatten into generic luxury sans.

items.title: About Google Ads certifications
items.summary: Official Skillshop rules: 80% pass, 75 minutes, no pause, 1-day retake, 12-month validity. Search, Display, Video, Shopping, and Apps count toward the company Partner badge. Individual certs are personal.
items.fy_action: Sit Search + Measurement first. Put expiry dates on this dash when someone passes.
